CustomField.complianceGroup: Integrity - Accurate;Privacy - Non Personal Information;Source - Loan Domain
CustomField.description: Formula to display loan duration in years and months format
CustomField.formula: TEXT(FLOOR(AmortizationTerm/12)) & ' Years' & ' ' & IF(FLOOR(MOD(AmortizationTerm,12)) = 0, '', TEXT(FLOOR(MOD(AmortizationTerm,12))) & IF(FLOOR(MOD(AmortizationTerm,12)) = 1, ' Month ', ' Months '))
CustomField.label: Loan Term
